# DeskUtils 0.1.11
DeskUtils 0.1.11 makes window switching smoother, adds quick tool toggles during setup, and restores dragging for pinned screenshots and Clipboard on macOS 27.
## Improvements
- **Window Switcher** — cached previews appear immediately while updated snapshots load in the background. The selected window is refreshed first, with fewer unnecessary background captures. - **Onboarding** — enable or disable Color Picker, Clean Keyboard, Prevent Sleep, External Display Only, External Display Dimming, and Window Switcher directly during setup. - **Quick Ring** — added staggered icon entrance animations, smoother selection transitions, and clearer highlighting for the selected tool. Animations respect the system Reduce Motion setting. - **About** — release notes now open the [DeskUtils changelog](https://deskutils.app/changelog/), and the feedback action opens the [feedback and bug report page](https://deskutils.app/feedback/).
## Fixes
- Fixed pinned screenshots not moving when dragged on macOS 27. Locked screenshots remain fixed in place. - Fixed the Clipboard panel not moving when dragged from an empty area on macOS 27. - Fixed missing Dock Preview thumbnails when multiple preview requests occur at the same time. - Further improved onboarding window sizing on macOS 27 to prevent the setup window from stretching during initial layout.
## Notes
- Window Switcher is now enabled by default when no preference has been saved. Existing on/off preferences are preserved. - Window Switcher requires Accessibility permission. Screen Recording permission is optional and enables window previews. - Build 15. - Requires macOS 15.2 or later.

# DeskUtils 0.1.10
DeskUtils 0.1.10 is a hotfix release that improves Window Switcher stability and keeps onboarding at its intended size on macOS 27.
## Fixes
- Fixed a Window Switcher crash caused by duplicate window identities, including collisions involving minimized windows. - Fixed Settings windows appearing as unavailable in Window Switcher, including macOS System Settings and DeskUtils Settings. - Fixed stale Window Switcher thumbnails. Cached previews now expire and visible windows are captured again so their latest content is shown. - Fixed the onboarding window stretching to full-screen height on macOS 27. Resize proposals are constrained before display, and the setup window cannot enter full-screen mode.
## Notes
- Build 14. - Requires macOS 15.2 or later.

# DeskUtils 0.1.9
DeskUtils 0.1.9 adds Window Switcher with live window previews and Dock Preview, introduces Mouse Jiggler, and fixes the onboarding window height on macOS 27.
## What's New
- **Window Switcher** — an opt-in replacement for the macOS app switcher. Hold Command and press Tab (Shift-Tab reverses) to open a grid of every window on the display under the pointer, in the current Space, including occluded and minimized windows. Move through the grid with the arrow keys and release Command to focus the highlighted window; Return or a click focuses, Escape or an outside click cancels. A close button appears on the selected or hovered card, and closing a window never quits an app or answers a save dialog. Requires Accessibility; Screen Recording is optional and, when granted, enables live thumbnails (otherwise app icons and window titles are shown). - **Dock Preview** — hover a running app's Dock icon to preview its windows without leaving the Dock. It shows up to three cards before scrolling, follows the Dock's orientation (horizontal for a bottom Dock, vertical for side Docks), and swaps instantly as you move between icons. Clicking a card restores and focuses it, including a minimized window; hovering a card reveals a close button. It never consumes Dock clicks, and a secondary click (for example the Dock context menu) keeps it hidden so it cannot cover the menu. - **Mouse Jiggler** — keep the pointer active inside a screen, window, or custom area you choose, with an adjustable movement interval and automatic pause during user activity.
## Fixes
- Fixed the onboarding window growing beyond its intended maximum height on macOS 27. The window remains manually resizable within its supported size limits.
## Notes
- Window Switcher is off by default. Enable it in **Settings → Window Switcher**; it requires Accessibility access, and Screen Recording is optional for live previews. - Dock Preview is a separate setting, enabled by default once Window Switcher is on. - Build 13. - Requires macOS 15.2 or later.
